Three papers, two tools and one opinion ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏

ML Weekly #88

Hi there,

This week we look at three papers, two tools and one opinion piece. As always, reply to this email if you have suggestions.

1. Sparse attention at scale

The authors propose a block-sparse attention kernel that cuts memory use by 60% while keeping perplexity within 0.1 of dense attention.

2. Better retrieval with fewer tokens

A retrieval method that compresses passages before ranking. Results on BEIR: +2.3 nDCG@10.

3. Learning rate warm-up, revisited

Short answer: you still need it, but less of it.
